t: You're on Pall Mall East, a street in the City of Westminster. Douglas Kinnaird died here in 1830. He was a banker, a managing partner in the firm of Ransom and Company, and a friend of Lord Byron. He was also an amateur cricketer, and for a short time, from 1819 to 1820, he sat in Parliament as the Member for Bishop's Castle. He was only in his early forties when he died.
